question: What temporal span defines the duration of this preliminary rite?
premises: The practice begins on a fourteenth lunar day.
The practice continues until another fourteenth lunar day arrives.
inference: The preliminary rite spans the interval from one fourteenth day to the next.
uncertainties: Whether the span is one lunar fortnight or one full lunar month is not explicitly specified.
plain_english: Beginning on the fourteenth day, continue until the next fourteenth day.
